key_insight: PerovAgent autonomously searches perovskite surface-capping ligands while turning recurring chemical observations into testable design principles.
engineering_relevance: The framework could guide ligand selection for halide perovskite nanocrystals by combining binding-energy optimization with validated chemical insights.
method: Use LLM-driven multi-agent reasoning to propose and refine ligand chemistries.
Construct atomistic models and evaluate binding energies with machine-learned interatomic potentials.
Statistically test design principles and audit potential confounding.
evidence_signal: Across 10 independent CsPbBr3 surface campaigns, 19 of 35 principles gained prospective support, seven also passed the confound audit, and DFT reproduced one recurrent alkynyl-phosphonate energetic preference.
watch_item: Computational binding-energy improvements do not establish experimental nanocrystal performance, and most proposed principles lacked confound-audited support.
paper_title: PerovAgent: Autonomous Ligand Design for Halide Perovskite Nanocrystals
